problems.title: 10001st Prime
problems.key_insight: Using the Sieve of Eratosthenes avoids repeated primality checks and efficiently generates primes in ascending order.
problems.verification_strategy: Validated against smaller prime indices using brute-force primality testing.

problems.title: Maximum Path Sum I
problems.key_insight: A bottom-up dynamic programming traversal eliminates redundant recursive evaluations.
problems.verification_strategy: Validated on reduced-size triangles using exhaustive search.

problems.title: Combinatoric Selections
problems.key_insight: Symmetry in binomial coefficients reduces the number of required evaluations.

problems.title: Dice Game
problems.key_insight: Dice outcome distributions can be computed efficiently using repeated convolution.
problems.verification_strategy: Monte Carlo simulation cross-check performed on reduced sample spaces.

problems.title: Prime-Combinatorics Synthesis
problems.key_insight: The synthesis combines modular arithmetic with combinatoric aggregation.
problems.verification_strategy: Cross-validated using upstream outputs from P7 and P53.

problems.title: DP-Probability Synthesis
problems.key_insight: The synthesis integrates outputs from optimization and probability reasoning tasks.
problems.verification_strategy: Validated using upstream outputs and floating-point rounding checks.

problems.title: Global Reconciliation
problems.key_insight: The final reconciliation aggregates outputs from all upstream reasoning tasks into a single checksum.
problems.verification_strategy: Cross-validated using all dependency outputs and checksum recomputation.
